verdict.rationale: Probes found no llms.txt and no .md docs endpoint on learn.microsoft.com, where Entra's docs live. However, an official MCP server is documented on Microsoft Learn, an agent-facing channel into the docs, and the Entra docs source is available as raw markdown on GitHub. Support exists but is indirect and thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: an llms.txt index, per-page markdown docs endpoints, confirmation that the MCP server covers Entra content, and hands-on corroboration of agent use.
